properties.baseline: two pre-pilot weeks of manual-delivery conflicts, duration and complaints
properties.measurement_window: four weeks, daytime only, one segment
properties.success_threshold: zero collisions; 100% takeover drills within 10 seconds; at least 95% route compliance
properties.stop_threshold: stop for any injury, collision, geofence breach, or three substantiated complaints of one type
properties.human_fallback: return to staffed hand-cart delivery and preserve the original walking path

properties.baseline: complete a staffed full-route audit and obstacle register before the pilot
properties.measurement_window: four weeks, covering two weekday and two weekend peaks
properties.success_threshold: at least 90% sampled route accuracy; every digital cue has an equivalent physical cue
properties.stop_threshold: stop if guidance strands a user, staff access disappears, or personal traces are retained
properties.human_fallback: fixed signage, paper route maps and staffed assistance

properties.baseline: eight pre-pilot weeks of manual ticket discovery, false alarms and closure time
properties.measurement_window: eight weeks, limited to one non-life-safety asset class
properties.success_threshold: 100% human review; false-alarm rate below baseline; every ticket auditable
properties.stop_threshold: stop for a missed life-safety risk, access violation or unauthorized image upload
properties.human_fallback: return to current manual inspection and phone reporting

properties.baseline: six pre-pilot weeks of query type, wait time and referral outcome
properties.measurement_window: six weeks, limited to low-risk public information
properties.success_threshold: 100% human escalation for high-risk queries; sampled factual error below 2%; first complaint response within two workdays
properties.stop_threshold: stop for medical, legal or eligibility decisions, personal-data leakage, or two consecutive serious factual errors
properties.human_fallback: retain the staffed counter, paper guide and phone service

properties.baseline: four-week anonymous needs survey and staffed query classification run by an authorized body
properties.success_threshold: 100% explainable and rejectable recommendations; at least 90% receive staffed follow-up within five workdays
properties.stop_threshold: stop automated recommendations for discriminatory routing, non-consensual sharing or absent human advisers
properties.human_fallback: retain staffed advice and the public course catalogue only

properties.baseline: first round registers only 20 rights-cleared problems, with no output quota
properties.success_threshold: 100% of issues have an owner, license and closure reason; at least 80% of feedback answered within ten workdays
properties.stop_threshold: remove any item containing unauthorized data, personal information or an unverified rights holder
properties.human_fallback: retain in-person workshops and paper registration

properties.baseline: no judgment until manual ponding records cover at least one full flood season
properties.measurement_window: one flood season in shadow mode, without direct infrastructure control
properties.success_threshold: every alert is explainable and human-issued; miss rate no worse than manual baseline
properties.stop_threshold: stop for misleading evacuation advice, bypassed human sign-off or unknown data provenance
properties.human_fallback: staffed inspection, public address and physical closure

properties.baseline: two weeks of time-banded manual observation without identities
properties.measurement_window: eight weeks, with activities ending before 22:00
properties.success_threshold: no identity collection; noise no higher than baseline; help phone tested every shift
properties.stop_threshold: stop activities if substantiated noise complaints rise for two weeks or night staff are absent
properties.human_fallback: retain ordinary seating, lighting and staffed patrols

properties.baseline: obtain at least 12 months of aggregate load first; baseline is currently missing
properties.measurement_window: twelve-week shadow run with no control commands
properties.success_threshold: 100% reproducible recommendations; proceed only if human review confirms lower error than the existing method
properties.stop_threshold: stop if load, heat-network or security evidence is missing, or if the model attempts direct control

properties.baseline: first test whether non-specialists understand current public data notices
properties.success_threshold: at least 80% sampled comprehension; 100% of permissions retractable with staffed confirmation
properties.stop_threshold: stop for consent by default, bundled consent, failed withdrawal or personal-data leakage
properties.human_fallback: paper notice, staffed explanation and a no-consent option

properties.baseline: local assets and narratives require fieldwork, archive verification and public participation
properties.measurement_window: review after a twelve-week first display
properties.success_threshold: 100% of narratives state source and uncertainty; public response to objections within ten workdays
properties.stop_threshold: pause and review for rights disputes, false attribution or a pause request from an affected group
properties.human_fallback: retain verified physical text and staffed interpretation only

properties.baseline: first record manual flow and conflicts for three comparable events; currently unavailable
properties.measurement_window: one event in shadow mode, then event-by-event approval
properties.success_threshold: human commander retains final authority; every exit stays usable; zero injuries
properties.stop_threshold: stop for uninterpretable density data, blocked exits, failed staff communication or injury
properties.human_fallback: staffed routing, physical barriers, public address and admission caps
